note: G equals m g with the default settings

default mass 10 kg on Maa gives G = 98,1 N

setup: const s=document.querySelector('#sim-root select'); s.value='Kuu'; document.querySelector('#sim-root input[type=range]').value=5;

note: mass is read from the slider and does not depend on the body

expr: (() => { const x=document.querySelector('#sim-root .readout').textContent; return x.includes('G = m · g = 98,1 N') && x.includes('g = 9,81 m/s²') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: readout is DOM text: m = 10 kg, g = 9,81 m/s², G = 98,1 N
the select offers exactly Kuu, Mars, Maa, Jupiter

expr: (() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); return c.width===600 && c.height===400 ? 1 : 0 })()

note: the mass slider label carries the unit kg

expr: (async () => { const s=document.querySelector('#sim-root select'), r=document.querySelector('#sim-root input[type=range]'); const w=()=>new Promise(f=>setTimeout(f,200)); s.value='Maa'; r.value=10; await w(); const a=window.simState.stretch; r.value=100; await w(); const b=window.simState.stretch; return b>a*1.5 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: spring stretch grows with the mass slider (spring stretches in proportion to the weight G = m g)

expr: (async () => { const s=document.querySelector('#sim-root select'), r=document.querySelector('#sim-root input[type=range]'); const w=()=>new Promise(f=>setTimeout(f,200)); s.value='Kuu'; r.value=5; await w(); const a=window.simState.stretch/window.simState.G; s.value='Jupiter'; r.value=80; await w(); const b=window.simState.stretch/window.simState.G; return Math.abs(a-b)<0.01*a ? 1 : 0 })()
note: spring stretch is proportional to G across bodies and masses (stretch/G constant)

expr: (async () => { const s=document.querySelector('#sim-root select'), r=document.querySelector('#sim-root input[type=range]'); const w=()=>new Promise(f=>setTimeout(f,200)); const out=[]; for (const b of ['Kuu','Mars','Maa','Jupiter']) { s.value=b; r.value=7; await w(); out.push(window.simState.stretch); } s.value='Maa'; r.value=10; await w(); return out[0]<out[1] && out[1]<out[2] && out[2]<out[3] ? 1 : 0 })()
note: spring stretch grows Kuu < Mars < Maa < Jupiter for the same mass

expr: (() => { const r=document.querySelector('#sim-root input[type=range]'); return r.min==='1' && r.max==='100' ? 1 : 0 })()

(async () => { const s=document.querySelector('#sim-root select'), r=document.querySelector('#sim-root input[type=range]'); const w=()=>new Promise(f=>setTimeout(f,200)); s.value='Maa'; r.value=10; await w(); const a=window.simState.bars.slice(); r.value=100; await w(); const b=window.simState.bars.slice(); r.value=10; await w(); return b.every((x,i)=>Math.abs(x/a[i]-10)<0.01) ? 1 : 0 })()
note: bar heights are proportional to G: ten times the mass gives ten times the bar height for every body

expr: (async () => { const s=document.querySelector('#sim-root select'), r=document.querySelector('#sim-root input[type=range]'); const w=()=>new Promise(f=>setTimeout(f,200)); s.value='Jupiter'; r.value=100; await w(); const b=window.simState.bars[3]; const st=window.simState.stretch; s.value='Maa'; r.value=10; await w(); return b>0 && b<=220.01 && st<=190.01 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: full scale (100 kg on Jupiter) fits the chart: bar at most 220 px, stretch at most 190 px

expr: (async () => { const s=document.querySelector('#sim-root select'), r=document.querySelector('#sim-root input[type=range]'); const w=()=>new Promise(f=>setTimeout(f,200)); s.value='Maa'; r.value=10; await w(); const e=window.simState.arrow; s.value='Kuu'; await w(); const k=window.simState.arrow; s.value='Maa'; r.value=10; await w(); return k>0 && Math.abs(e/k-9.81/1.62)<0.05*(9.81/1.62) ? 1 : 0 })()
note: weight arrow is proportional to G: arrow(10 kg, Maa) / arrow(10 kg, Kuu) = 9,81 / 1,62 = 6,06 within 5 %

expr: (async () => { const s=document.querySelector('#sim-root select'), r=document.querySelector('#sim-root input[type=range]'); const w=()=>new Promise(f=>setTimeout(f,200)); s.value='Maa'; r.value=100; await w(); const e=window.simState.arrow; s.value='Kuu'; await w(); const k=window.simState.arrow; s.value='Jupiter'; await w(); const j=window.simState.arrow; const G=window.simState.G; s.value='Maa'; r.value=10; await w(); return k>3 && Math.abs(e/k-9.81/1.62)<0.05*(9.81/1.62) && Math.abs(j/G-e/981)<0.01*(e/981) && j<=120 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: arrow is proportional to G above the 3 px floor (100 kg: Maa/Kuu = 6,06, arrow/G constant) and the longest arrow (100 kg on Jupiter) is at most 120 px so it fits the canvas
